data_license: Original synthetic numerical fixture under repository MIT license; no copied third-party tables.
independence_limit: Independent numerical implementation of elementary geometry, not an independent physical optical experiment. Resolution and label coefficients are application conventions, not validated measurements.

policy.excluded: Distortion, vignetting, aberrations, measured resolution/seeing, spherical mosaics, rotations, near-field focus, arbitrary IEEE extreme inputs.
policy.heuristics: Uncalibrated; boundary contract tests are separate from reference accuracy.
policy.rationale: Half output quantum plus 1e-10 absolute arithmetic allowance; integer topology exact. Fixed before production evaluation.
policy.scope: Ideal rectilinear infinity-focus geometry, declared 206.265 plate-scale constant, conventional resolution coefficients, planar axis-aligned tiling.

reference_method: 90-digit Decimal half-angle/alternating atan and Machin pi; Fraction coverage enumeration; no production imports; stdlib only.

references.supports: Full angular field = 2 atan(sensor dimension/(2 focal length)); ideal model limitations.
Focal-length/magnification relationship and dependence of useful magnification on observing conditions. Its 60x/inch recommendation differs from the app 2x/mm heuristic; not a calibration.
